nodes.title: SG-2.2 · Single Zustand owner of GameState
nodes.body:
Context: persistence.ts is already versioned (SG-2.1). GameState lives once in game/src/state/types.ts. useGame.ts still reads the saved game itself (readSaved) and writes it from a useEffect (writeSaved), and it casts the nullable store state with `as GameState`. Desired behaviour: gameStore.ts hydrates from the save and persists on every change, and useGame and App only read and write through the store. Expected result: no component or hook keeps a second copy or touches runtime/storage. Why: the SG-2 sub-goal requires one owner of GameState.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a saved game exists, when the store hydrates, then state equals the saved state; with no or corrupt save it equals createInitialState(world, scene)
- Given a store update, when setState runs, then the new state is saved through runtime/storage and the versioned persistence functions
- Given useGame and App source, when inspected, then neither imports runtime/storage or casts the store state
- Given the existing save and reload tests, when run, then they pass, rewritten against behaviour where they pinned internals


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts
- In scope: frontend/src/runtime/useGame.ts
- In scope: Tests for save and reload behaviour
- Out of scope: Changes to persistence.ts format or CURRENT_VERSION
- Out of scope: backend/ and frontend/src/api/client.ts
- Out of scope: New features, content or art
- Preserve: Saves in the old format still load
- Preserve: Intro, scene, object focus and interaction, story panel, inventory, transitions, save and reload play the same
- Preserve: The existing phaser-pin guard test


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test must keep passing
- No change to what the player sees or can do
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests that pinned internals are rewritten against behaviour
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- Tests mock only what is external (localStorage)
- backend/ and api/client.ts are out of scope


## Definition of done
- gameStore.ts is the only owner and the only caller of readSaved/writeSaved
- Both requirements are verified by passing unit tests
- npm test and npm run typecheck are green in game/ and game/frontend/


## Non-functional requirements
- No extra localStorage writes beyond one per state change


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The store hydrates from the save and persists every state change
nodes.body:
Context: gameStore.ts has init and setState but no persistence; useGame.ts calls readSaved and writeSaved. Desired behaviour: the store exposes hydrate() that replaces state with readSaved() ?? createInitialState(world, scene) and writes it, and setState saves each new state with writeSaved. Expected result: save and reload work with no caller outside the store. Why: one owner of GameState.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a valid save in storage, when hydrate() runs, then store state deep-equals the saved state
- Given no save or a corrupt save, when hydrate() runs, then store state equals createInitialState(world, scene)
- Given an initialised store, when setState(updater) runs, then writeSaved is called with the new state
- Given writeSaved fails because storage throws, when setState runs, then the store still holds the new state and nothing throws


## Scope
- In scope: hydrate action
- In scope: persist on setState
- Out of scope: persistence.ts format
- Out of scope: focusedObjectId handling
- Preserve: init is still a no-op when state is set
- Preserve: setState is still a no-op before init
- Preserve: setFocusedObject unchanged


## Technical constraints
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- gameStore.ts stays under 200 lines
- Import GameState from @game/state/types only
- game/src never imports from game/frontend


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- hydrate exists and persists
- setState persists
- Existing store tests still pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Storage failure never throws


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · useGame and App read and write GameState only through the store
nodes.body:
Context: useGame.ts calls readSaved, writes with a useEffect and casts `as GameState`; App.tsx uses useGame and the store. Desired behaviour: useGame hydrates through useGameStore.getState().hydrate(), selects state from the store with a null guard and no cast, and has no save effect. Expected result: save and reload behave as before and only the store talks to storage.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a mount, when useGame runs, then state comes from the store and a remount after act() shows the saved flag secret_door_open true
- Given a corrupt save, when useGame mounts, then the intro dialogue is active and play continues when writes throw
- Given useGame.ts source, when read, then it does not import runtime/storage or contain `as GameState`
- Given App, when the player acts, then the story panel shows the store state


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/runtime/useGame.ts
- In scope: App flow behaviour tests
- Out of scope: Changing returned UseGame shape
- Out of scope: Phaser BootScene logic
- Preserve: UseGame type: state, scene, view, act, choose
- Preserve: App.tsx rendering and handleAction events


## Technical constraints
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- No parallel useState copy of GameState in components
- Files under 200 lines
- No test deleted or skipped


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- useGame has no storage import, no save effect and no cast
- App flow and persistence tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Add hydrate and persist-on-setState to gameStore
nodes.body:
Add a hydrate action to GameStoreState and call writeSaved in setState and hydrate so the store alone loads and saves through runtime/storage, which already wraps the versioned persistence functions.

## Acceptance criteria
- hydrate sets state to readSaved() ?? createInitialState(world, scene) and writes it
- setState saves the updater result with writeSaved
- init, setFocusedObject and the null guard keep their behaviour


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts
- Out of scope: useGame.ts
- Out of scope: persistence.ts
- Preserve: init no-op when set
- Preserve: setState no-op before init


## Technical constraints
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- File under 200 lines
- No test changes in this unit
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts`


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- hydrate declared in GameStoreState and implemented
- setState calls writeSaved after set
- npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend

nodes.title: Verify: useGame and App save and reload behaviour unit tests
nodes.body:

- Corrupt save starts at intro and tolerates throwing writes
- useGame.ts has no runtime/storage import and no `as GameState`

- Out of scope: e2e, browser or live checks

- Tests mock only localStorage (or the storage module in appFlow, as today)
- Real store never mocked
- Source check reads the file with node:fs from the real repo path

- useGame, secretDoorPersistence, appFlow and new tests pass
